# Castel Sant'Angelo

> > Official guide to Castel Sant'Angelo (Mole Adriana) in Rome: tickets, visiting hours, history from Hadrian's mausoleum to papal fortress, and practical visitor information.

Comprehensive resource for visiting Castel Sant'Angelo, covering the monument's 2,000-year transformation from imperial tomb to military fortress to national museum. Includes practical details for the Passetto di Borgo, exhibitions, nearby accommodations and dining, plus cultural events like the Girandola fireworks.

## Key Topics

- Castel Sant'Angelo (Mole Adriana)
- Hadrian's Mausoleum
- Passetto di Borgo
- Vatican and Vaticano
- Ponte Sant'Angelo (Sant'Angelo Bridge)
- Museo Nazionale
- Rome attractions and monuments
- Arcangelo Michele (Archangel Michael)
- Tiber River (Tevere)
- Papal fortress history
- Opening hours and schedules
- Ticket reservations
- Piazza Navona area
- Roman Forum (Foro Romano)
- Renaissance frescoes and art

- [Where Is Castel Sant'Angelo and How to Get There Easily](https://castelsantangelo.com/en/where-is-castel-sant-angelo): English guide: location and transport options to reach Mole Adriana

- [Castel Sant'Angelo: A Brief and Complete History of the Castle](https://castelsantangelo.com/en/castel-sant-angelo-history): English version: history from imperial mausoleum to modern museum
- [Castel Sant'Angelo: Curiosità, Leggende e Fatti Incredibili](https://castelsantangelo.com/castel-sant-angelo-curiosita): Legends, ghosts, secret passages: Arcangelo Michele, Cellini stories
- [Passetto di Borgo: Tickets, How to Visit, Hours, Prices](https://castelsantangelo.com/en/passetto-di-borgo): Papal escape corridor tickets and visiting info for Vatican passageway

- [The Dawn of a Museum Castel Sant'Angelo: Tickets, Hours, Useful Info](https://castelsantangelo.com/en/exhibition-dawn-of-a-museum-castel-sant-angelo): English: 1911-1925 centenary exhibition tickets and visiting details
- [Sala della Biblioteca Castel Sant'Angelo: Cosa Vedere e Orari](https://castelsantangelo.com/sala-della-biblioteca-castel-sant-angelo): Paolo III's Renaissance library room with grotesque frescoes and decor
